### Executive Summary

Palo Alto Networks' firewall operating system has been actively targeted by multiple ransomware groups. According to reporting from *The Register*, threat actors have been focusing exploitation efforts against the security platform since June. 

The ongoing campaigns highlight continued adversary interest in network perimeter infrastructure to gain initial access for enterprise-wide ransomware deployment.

### Technical Impact & Root Cause

Multiple ransomware threat groups are actively targeting devices running Palo Alto's firewall OS. Successful exploitation of edge appliances typically allows threat actors to bypass perimeter controls, establish persistence, and pivot deeper into internal corporate networks.
